items.name: Artificer's measure
items.evidence: Wiki full process: four restored Orthen artefacts (dragon scalpel, protective goggles, orthenglass flask, pasaha) excavate at Orthen Dig Site / Crypt of Varanus on Anachronia — hard self-source. Upgraded gem bag is 20k DG tokens (Daemonheim / Forinthry). Glorious silvthril chain needs chain link mould from partial Legacy of Seergaze (Morytania). Blessed molten glass needs crystal-flecked sandstone (Prif mining / Tirannwn) with Player-Owned Ports as slower alternate — Tirannwn is strong self-source but not absolute. Answer to 'should 1 host Anachronia?': YES as primary host (Orthen craft spine), not as sole required region. Keep multi-region requiredRegions; clamp multi-host display to primary anachronia. League unobtainable flag (4-region pick) is still valid under ironman self-sufficiency.

notes.primaryHostReason: Orthen artefact components are the non-substitutable hard craft end

alternates.morytania: mould gate if Legacy of Seergaze not auto-completed in League
alternates.forinthry: upgraded gem bag is hard DG reward

items.name: Ring of slaying (craft unlock)
items.evidence: Wiki: craft unlock is 300 Slayer points purchased from any Slayer Master (global points, not a region gate). Craft is 75 Crafting + enchanted gem + gold bar at any furnace; Assist/boosts OK if unlock owned. Alternate is buy finished rings at 75 points each without the unlock. Teleport destinations (Sumona/Desert, Slayer Tower/Morytania, Fremennik Slayer Dungeon, Tarn's Lair after Haunted Mine/Misthalin) are destination pressure only — they must not inflate requiredRegions for the craft-unlock row. Catalog all_required desert+morytania+fremennik+misthalin is wrong for craft. Host Misthalin is a reasonable display home (starting campus / many masters), not a hard gate.

notes.catalogBug: requiredRegions currently lists teleport destinations as all_required

items.name: Crystal fishing rod + Prif waterfall + Fury shark stack
items.evidence: Wiki crystal fishing rod: unlock 3,000 crystal urchin points from Prifddinas Waterfall Fishing Shop; craft at Ithell singing bowl (crystal tool seed + 150 harmonic dust, 80 Smithing) or NPC enchant (Ilfeen/Eluned/Islwyn/Rhodri). All hard gates are Tirannwn/Prif (Plague's End for Prif access). Catch bonus stacks with fury shark outfit, but fury shark is a separate Kandarin Deep Sea fragment + Invention path — not required to own or use the rod. Catalog stack hard-requires kandarin; that over-gates the rod. Prefer: requiredRegions=[tirannwn] only; fury shark optional pressure or split/remove combo (matches prior B10 fury-combo remove ruling). Rod-only equipment residual should stay tirannwn-only.

notes.catchBonusWiki: +8% on rod-required spots (catalog sometimes says +5% — wiki examine/page say 8%)
notes.relatedRuling: KEEP Crystal fishing rod on [tirannwn] req=[tirannwn]; REMOVE fury shark combo

items.name: Expansive essence pouch (70 essence, non-degrading)
items.evidence: Wiki Expansive pouch process: hungry hood 20k Runespan points from Wizard Rinsit (Wizards' Tower — Misthalin); feed small→massive pouches; expansive pouch cord needs Ilme's thread + 100 magical thread (magical thread from Abyss altar trips — Forinthry/Wilderness pressure); exterior needs sign of runic protection + royal dragon leather + dinosaur leather + felt; combine at non-necrotic altar; unseal via large Runedoku; fill at Rune Essence mine. Hard ironman dual: Misthalin (Rinsit/Runespan shop + essence mine fill) + Forinthry (Abyss magical-thread loop). Anachronia is optional for self-sourced dinosaur leather (tradeable materials exist outside League; no-trade League makes Anachronia pressure, not catalog-hard today). Catalog misthalin+forinthry keep is correct.

notes.optionalReason: dinosaur leather / altar geography convenience, not hard craft infrastructure

items.name: Elder divination outfit path (Cache base + Invention elite)
items.evidence: Wiki elder path: train Divination (70+) to collect divination fragments anywhere (90–110 / 5 min, not Cache-locked); discover skilling-outfit blueprint (80 Div + 80 Craft + 80 Smith + Invention); craft energy/chronicle/memory pieces at inventor's workbench from 3,600 fragments each (20 Invention); combine three outfits into elder. Invention unlock + workbench discovery geography is Asgarnia (Invention Guild). Guthixian Cache / Memorial (Kandarin) is the efficient base diviner's outfit route for XP inheritance and modified head energy-save — useful but not a hard gate for the Invention fragment elder set. Catalog all_required kandarin+asgarnia overstates Cache. Related: plain 'Elder divination outfit' rows were user-ruled REMOVE as global/elite; this path row can stay if demoted to Asgarnia primary with Kandarin optional. Prefer no TH acquisition path.

notes.relatedRemove: Elder divination outfit (equipment residual) remains remove/global per E-class ruling

items.name: Extreme invention supply combo (Guild + webbing + Herblore) / mycelial webbing mushroom-patch region
items.evidence: Wiki extreme invention: mix super invention (3) + mycelial webbing at 95 Herblore (Assist cannot make). Mycelial webbing is POF zygomite produce (Zanarian 2, Arcspore/Daemoncap 3, Magical 4 per growth stage) — NOT a direct mushroom-patch harvest. Zygomites are raised in medium pens at Manor Farm (Kandarin POF hub; tutorial 17 Farming / 20 Construction north of East Ardougne). Unchecked gloomshroom zygomites come from harvesting bittercap/morchella/Arc mushrooms or Mort Myre fungus, or Zygomite Carestyling. Mushroom patches (for seed zygomites) are: west of Canifis (Morytania — primary free patch), Isafdar (Tirannwn, medium diary), City of Um (Misthalin, 80 Necromancy). Catalog hard-requires Anachronia for webbing self-supply; wiki does not — Anachronia Ranch is optional parallel POF geography, not the webbing source of truth. Correct ironman self-supply: Asgarnia (Invention Guild use-case / super-invention training home) + Kandarin (Manor Farm zygomites → webbing). Mushroom-patch region for acquiring zygomites is primarily Morytania (Canifis), not Anachronia.

notes.catalogBug: requiredRegions includes anachronia; should be asgarnia+kandarin (Anachronia optional only)
